title: Quick Char Grilled Greek Lamb Gyro
description: A tangy and creamy Greek dish featuring lamb, chilli, and a char-grilled flavor, perfect for a date night, this gyro is sugar-free friendly and packed with flavor.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together chilli flakes and olive oil to create a marinade.
Add the sliced lamb to the marinade and toss to coat, letting it sit for 5 minutes.
Grill the lamb for 4-5 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it on the grill for 2 minutes.
Assemble the gyro by spreading tzatziki sauce on the pita, then adding the grilled lamb, onion, tomato, cucumber, and feta cheese.
Top with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
Let each person assemble their own gyro to their liking.
